page.overview:
Who is Bacardi Woman?

The Bacardi Woman is a woman who works for the Bacardi company. She advertises for the product in locations such as Stu's Disco, pretending to take interest in men to get them to listen to her praise of Bacardi Colada. This proved unsuccessful with Moe Szyslak, who was disappointed to learn she was only feigning her interest in him.
